Detailed SOP is available for all major work activities to adhere & a Permit to work system ensures all work is done with required precautions. MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheets) for the chemicals are available to act in accordance while handling them in the plant. Routine surveillance and reporting of adverse events is in practice for investigation and corrective actions are taken.
